NEXT, per Alex — the chain, and nothing off it:

1. **BEB-2311 (in-tick deploy step)** — the only thing that turns claims into completions. Now claimable by the loop itself. This is the first real test of the loop building loop machinery. Do NOT hand-edit it; let the loop claim it. If the loop cannot, report why rather than reaching for break-glass.
2. **BEB-2305** — /prove-deploy green from inside the container, once 2311 gives the tick a deploy step. This was the deadlocked ticket; it is the proof the deadlock is actually gone.
3. **BEB-2308** — loop-status v2. Weight-10 proof goal, target date already passed (2026-07-25). It has been waiting on 2305 since 24 Jul. Ships through the cloud pipe, contract first, Fable render-probes before DONE.
4. **BEB-2156** — CC out of build. Target binding now added on the ticket, so the gate 3 refusal at m2758 clears. Do not BUILD-claim it ahead of 2311.

Alex: canned-gd.md is the closest we have to the existing embeds. Recover from there with the loop when the loop can. Detail on BEB-879.

Critical distinction so nothing restarts the wrong thing: 879 is written as an ingest/vectorize pipeline, and Alex killed corpus ingestion today (2331 cancelled). This is RECOVERY — inventory what already exists (canned-gd.md itself, any Vectorize index, D1 knowledge_fts, R2 bebond-knowledge keys, the old Vectorize:Edit token blocker) and report before anything rebuilds. If the vectors survive, the job is reconnecting, not regenerating.

Also noted: Alex gave CC canned-gd as the SOLUTION doc to reverse-engineer — deriving real GD behaviour from curated answers. Different use of the same file, and the one that fits the active-tickets/active-pickup rule. Keep them separate.

Priority unchanged: 2311 lands today. This waits.

CORRECTION to m2766 — Alex: Vectorize is STILL LIVE, and the original GD docs may be in the index alongside canned.

So the 879 recovery is smaller than stated: no rebuild, no re-embed. Query the live index. The 879 schema carries `source: 'canned' | 'official'` — one filtered query per source gives the inventory. Report: vector counts per source and lang, metadata fields actually indexed, index name and dim.

And the point Alex has been making all session, now explicit: canned-gd is a SOLUTIONS doc — each entry is an answer, and the QUESTION has to be reversed out of it. The answers are already embedded. What is missing is the question side plus the precondition each answer holds under (GD version, addon, template, setting). That is the backward/diagnosis direction and it is why this is not the ingest work that was killed.

Order unchanged: 2311 lands first. This is inventory-then-report, no writes.

SHARPENED again by Alex — the protocol is the asset, not the answers.

The answers are in the doc and already embedded. What was never captured is the PROCEDURE each canned solution encodes: working from what the user said to what was actually wrong, then to the fix.

Per solution, five parts: presenting complaint (user's words) → real issue → the discriminating checks that got from one to the other → fix (already in the doc) → precondition it holds under.

Part 3 is the whole point and the part nobody wrote down. An answer only helps when the incoming question matches one already solved; the checks generalise to issues that are NOT in the doc. That is the attending agent's job.

It is also the trainable layer per Alex's split today — procedure is stable across GD versions and across plugins, instance facts stay retrieved.

Read-and-derive over a live index plus an existing file. No re-embed, no ingest. Do a HANDFUL first and show Alex the shape before anything runs at volume.

Order unchanged: 2311 first.
